skyline.rule: Signature postcard shot: downtown silhouette framed at the end of Hennepin looking north. Never let a building block that sightline from the Hennepin/Lagoon corner. Blue-violet, lit windows at night, unreachable.

base.notes: Converted brick warehouse on Irving between W 28th & Lagoon. Ground: garage/training. Upper: squad loft. Roof: skyline view. Only player-owned interior at start. Private ramp to the Greenway trench = secret exit.

islesTrust.expression: No banners, no turf, no flips. Holds paper: liens on blocks in all three territories plus the contractor's municipal lease and corridor liens. Paired estate-security walkers posted near liened properties; at the zone perimeter's edge exactly twice a week to inspect the collateral. Never enters the flip system.
islesTrust.notes: Rep track gates capital and society access, not corners (settled cross-doc decision).

venues.name: Farhia's Halal Market

venues.name: Mercado Estrella del Norte
venues.notes: Inside the wire. Occupied EVE is curfew-truncated (shutters come down early); hours extend into EVE then LATE as the zone recedes. Mast M4 on this block's roof.

venues.name: La Golondrina Panaderia
venues.evokes: Corridor family bakery - the kid's maternal family's store
venues.notes: Inside the wire. First-light bake at MORN open (6a); no 4am phase exists. Combat disabled (family cell - the fight happens at the wire, never in it). Family names owned by docs/04. Mast M3 above.

venues.name: Taqueria El Relampago
venues.notes: Shell (post-slice). Shuttered at ship; the first storefront to visibly re-open as the zone recedes - shutters up, lightning bolt repainted, music on.

venues.name: The Quiet Door
venues.notes: Unmarked micro-cell budgeted with non-venue interiors, not the 20. One room: cots, coffee, a laminated route map nobody photographs. Never appears on the in-game map or minimap. Dev-only marker in the figure.

gates.name: East gate

holding.name: The Ramp
holding.notes: Commandeered municipal parking structure mid-zone. Ground: induction pads + processing kiosks. Upper decks: holding pens behind privacy scrim (dread by implication, never spectacle). Roof: mast M1. Also where the winter farmers market goes.

perimeter.rule: Border light rule (binding): the seam between the two is the arc's signature image - frame it from the Hotdish House windows. Modular barrier segments, retroreflective chevrons, one per ~10m, instanced mesh. Crosses Lake St just east of Hennepin, runs east along the corridor's north curb, wraps the east map edge, returns along W 31st.

zone.notes: Overlay layer with its own state model (docs/02) - NOT a fourth flip faction. Zone-state layers on top of whatever turf cells sit on or border. Units dock ~20 min per pad cycle (stealth windows). Destroying a mast kills the beige floodlights block by block in its radius.

densityRule: Every block face has at minimum door-decals and lit windows; ~2-4 facades per block are true enterable venues or shells. Filler shells still get stoops, AC units, and porch furniture - nothing reads as flat.
